module_summary: Serial accumulator: a 2-bit counter tracks four accepted 8-bit inputs summed into a 10-bit register, pulsing valid_out for one cycle when the fourth arrives.

anchors.name: count
anchors.why: Counts accepted inputs 0-3; selects load vs accumulate and triggers end_cnt.

anchors.name: data_out
anchors.why: 10-bit running sum register, loaded at count 0 then accumulates data_in; output.

anchors.name: valid_out
anchors.why: One-cycle output valid pulse after fourth input accumulated.

anchors.name: ready_add
anchors.why: Accept condition (valid_in or not valid_out) enabling count and accumulate.

anchors.name: end_cnt
anchors.why: Fourth-input event: wraps counter and sets valid_out.

anchors.name: data_out_reg
anchors.why: Unused duplicate of the accumulator register; no fanout.

groups.name: accept_counter
groups.description: Input accept logic, group-of-four counter and output valid pulse.

groups.name: accumulator
groups.description: Adder and 10-bit sum register(s) accumulating data_in.
